topics.label: Accessible interactions
topics.description: Build keyboard, focus, labeling, and semantic interaction behavior into UI components.

topics.label: Component composition
topics.description: Choose component boundaries and APIs that keep behavior reusable without unnecessary abstraction.

topics.label: Controlled inputs
topics.description: Keep form controls and application state synchronized across user interactions.

topics.label: Derived UI state
topics.description: Derive visible state from canonical inputs instead of storing redundant or conflicting state.

topics.label: Effect lifecycle
topics.description: Reason about effect execution, dependencies, cleanup, and component lifecycle boundaries.

topics.label: React state updates
topics.description: Apply React state updates correctly when values depend on events, batching, or previous state.

topics.label: Discriminated unions
topics.description: Model variants with a stable discriminator so invalid combinations are difficult to represent.

topics.label: Declaration lifecycle
topics.description: Reason about hoisting, initialization, and temporal dead zone behavior for var, let, and const declarations.

topics.label: Exhaustive checking
topics.description: Make variant handling complete and surface missing cases during type checking.

topics.label: TypeScript generics
topics.description: Express relationships between reusable inputs and outputs without losing useful type information.

topics.label: Scope and closures
topics.description: Reason about lexical bindings captured by functions and how nested scopes or shadowing change which binding is read.

topics.label: Type narrowing
topics.description: Narrow uncertain values safely using runtime evidence understood by TypeScript.

topics.label: Type-safe API modeling
topics.description: Represent API success, error, optional, and variant data without unsafe assertions.

topics.label: Grouping and aggregation
topics.description: Group records and calculate summaries while preserving the required output shape.

topics.label: Immutable transformations
topics.description: Transform collections without mutating caller-owned inputs or shared nested values.

topics.label: Normalization and lookups
topics.description: Reshape nested or repeated data into stable keyed structures for efficient access.

topics.label: Stable ordering
topics.description: Preserve or deliberately define record order while filtering, merging, and sorting data.

topics.label: Validation and sanitization
topics.description: Validate uncertain input and produce a safe normalized output without hiding invalid cases.

topics.label: Complexity analysis
topics.description: Evaluate time and space costs and explain how input growth affects an approach.

topics.label: Graph and tree traversal
topics.description: Traverse hierarchical or connected data while handling visitation, depth, and termination correctly.

topics.label: Interval reasoning
topics.description: Compare, merge, or select ranges while handling boundary conditions explicitly.

topics.label: Lookup and matching
topics.description: Choose appropriate lookup structures and matching strategies for repeated comparisons.

topics.label: Priority selection
topics.description: Select or schedule candidates according to explicit priorities and tie-breaking rules.

topics.label: Async state modeling
topics.description: Keep loading, success, empty, and error states consistent throughout asynchronous work.

topics.label: Concurrency control
topics.description: Limit, coordinate, or serialize simultaneous asynchronous operations deliberately.

topics.label: Promise ordering
topics.description: Reason about initiation, completion, and result ordering across multiple promises.

topics.label: Request cancellation
topics.description: Stop or disregard asynchronous work that is no longer relevant to the current lifecycle.

topics.label: Retries and backoff
topics.description: Retry transient failures with explicit limits, delays, and terminal-error behavior.

topics.label: Stale async responses
topics.description: Prevent older asynchronous results from replacing state associated with newer work.

topics.label: Cache invalidation
topics.description: Decide when cached server data remains valid and when it must be refreshed or removed.

topics.label: API error mapping
topics.description: Convert transport and domain failures into stable application-facing error states.

topics.label: Optimistic updates
topics.description: Update local state before server confirmation and reconcile success, failure, and overlap.

topics.label: Pagination boundaries
topics.description: Handle page cursors, termination, duplicates, and boundary transitions correctly.

topics.label: Response adaptation
topics.description: Translate external response shapes into stable application models at a clear boundary.

topics.label: Async testing
topics.description: Test asynchronous observable behavior without relying on accidental timing.

topics.label: Behavior-oriented tests
topics.description: Verify public observable behavior instead of coupling tests to implementation details.

topics.label: Edge-case coverage
topics.description: Identify meaningful boundaries and failure modes that deserve explicit test cases.

topics.label: Mocking boundaries
topics.description: Mock external boundaries deliberately while preserving useful behavior and integration signal.

topics.label: Test isolation
topics.description: Keep tests independent from execution order, shared state, and leaked side effects.

topics.label: Large-list rendering
topics.description: Keep large collections responsive through appropriate rendering and update strategies.

topics.label: Memoization trade-offs
topics.description: Use memoization only where its comparison, memory, and complexity costs are justified.

topics.label: Request deduplication
topics.description: Avoid redundant equivalent network work while preserving correct freshness and consumers.

topics.label: Profiling and measurement
topics.description: Measure actual cost and confirm that an optimization improves the relevant bottleneck.

topics.label: Render cost
topics.description: Reduce unnecessary rendering and repeated work without breaking observable behavior.
